component-metadata.description:
The metanode creates table containing list of defined graphs to be imported into the Proteo-Visualizer application.
Volcano plot and scatter plot are currently suppported only, more graph types may be implemented later on.
Volcano plot: It requires log fold change and P value columns suffix and optionally also the colums prefix next to the comparisons name for which the Volcano plots should be defined. The script combines the prefix and suffix with the provided list of comparisons to specify which column should be displayed together in single Volcano plot and sets Volcano plots for all comparisons specified
Scatter plot: list of x and y axis column are needed to be provided. the script make thier pairwise lise (each x with each y ommiting scatter plot of the same columns)
